acceptance: The digest handles a PR whose commit count reaches the API listing limit without truncating evidence: for example, read the merged squash commit or compare base...head through the git data. It records that PR's soundness-path files completely, or records an explicit, owner-visible exception for it.
The checkpoint advances past #3902, and the backlog of soundness-path merges since 2026-11-03 (including #3962) is digested.
A unit test reproduces a PR at the listing limit and proves the digest neither truncates silently nor stalls permanently.

description: The soundness merge digest (`.github/workflows/soundness-merge-digest.yml`) has failed on every run since 2026-11-04: the scheduled runs on Nov 4 and 5, and a manual dispatch on Nov 6 (run 42220708367). Each fails with exit 2: `soundness-merge-digest: #3902 has 250 commits, the most the API lists; the checkpoint was not advanced`. PR #3902 (`chore(release): prepare 0.5.0rc3`, merged 2026-11-03) has more commits than the GitHub PR-commits endpoint returns. The script refuses rather than digest a truncated list, which is correct, but it never advances past the PR. So no soundness-path merge since Nov 3 has been digested, including the Theseus v0.2.1 migration (#3962, b0cfe591). This is not caused by the Theseus migration: the failures began before it, and the error is not a REVIEW_CONTEXT issue.
